authentication.enrollment: Manually enroll a Samsara API token as a bearer connection.
authentication.least_privilege: Every operation carries the exact human-readable Samsara API-token permission label documented by the official operation.
authentication.regional_origins: The per-organization connection may use the official US, EU, or CA origin; origin selection is never an operation argument.
authentication.oauth: Samsara Marketplace OAuth is not implemented by this static bearer connection descriptor and no renewal claim is made.

contract_gaps.moving_spec: Samsara publishes one current consolidated specification at a moving vendor URL. Every generated leaf retains this point-in-time byte hash and generation fails on drift.
contract_gaps.credential_lifecycle: Two driver-token issuance routes are connection-owned exclusions.
contract_gaps.functions: Thirteen Samsara Functions code, storage, deployment, log, and runtime routes are excluded to avoid exposing an arbitrary code-execution platform.
contract_gaps.query_arrays: OpenAPI form arrays with explode:false are exposed as comma-separated strings because the current REST adapter serializes array values as repeated query keys. explode:true arrays remain arrays.
contract_gaps.structured_request_schemas: The catalog validator permits additionalProperties:false only when every operation argument is scalar. Scalar-only operations are closed; operations with documented object or array arguments use the repository open-schema convention while still exposing only generated declared args.
contract_gaps.unsafe_integers: Every JSON response stringifies unsafe integers. Top-level int64 request fields use decimal_integer_fields on POST, PUT, and PATCH; four contracts with nested identity int64 values and one DELETE JSON body with an int64 identifier require explicit body_raw JSON.
contract_gaps.required_optional_bodies: Eighteen additional required JSON bodies have no individually required writable top-level property. They use required body_raw so an empty argument set cannot silently become a bodyless request.
contract_gaps.release_stages: Beta, preview, and legacy operations are admitted but labeled on every operation and in the audit fixture.
contract_gaps.sources: Issues and Work Orders are plausible task Sources, but declaration is deferred for the repository-mandated human field-path verification gate.
